h: DMI backs Tinubu's economic reforms and announces an alliance ahead of 2027
p: A group known as DMI has declared support for President Tinubu's economic reforms and announced an alliance with his campaign for the 2027 elections. The announcement follows the APC's campaign flag-off. Rival parties continue to court voters on cost-of-living concerns.
more: The alliance was announced a day after Tinubu's campaign speech in Kaduna.
Opposition parties say the reforms have worsened hardship.
Campaign groups on all sides are announcing alliances this week.
